Georgia Teen Arrested for Murdering Mother and Stepfather
A TEENAGER in Georgia has been arrested and charged with the murder of her parents from back in February. Sarah Grace Patrick is accused of killing her mother Kristin Brock, 41, and her stepfather James Brock, 45. The 17-year-old turned herself in Carroll County jail this week, months after her...
